name: Content Strategy
description: Plans what to write next for your sites. Discovers content opportunities from Google Search Console data, clusters them into topics, generates structured article briefs (with image requirements for downstream generation), and tracks each idea through an editorial queue from idea to published.

tools.name: create_site_profile
tools.description: Create or register a managed site profile (domain, brand, target languages, content categories, default CTA). Needed once per site before discovering opportunities for it.

business_description.description: One or two sentences on what the business does
business_description.title: Business Description

cta_default.description: Default call-to-action goal for articles on this site
cta_default.title: Cta Default

tools.name: list_site_profiles
tools.description: List all registered site profiles (managed sites).

tools.name: add_site_competitor
tools.description: Track a competitor for a managed site at the web/content level — which competing pages/sites rank or compete for the same topics, with observed strengths and weaknesses. Distinct from Brand Strategy Hub's brand-level competitors: this is about content/SERP rivals for THIS site specifically.

site_id.description: Site id from list_site_profiles — never invent it
site_id.title: Site Id

competing_topics.description: Topics/queries where this competitor ranks or competes for the same content
competing_topics.title: Competing Topics

return_schema.description:
One tracked competitor for a managed site — SERP/content rival,
not necessarily the same set as the brand's business-level competitors.
return_schema.title: SiteCompetitorProfile

tools.name: list_site_competitors
tools.description: List tracked web-level competitors, optionally filtered by site.

site_id.description: Optional site filter. Empty = all sites.
site_id.title: Site Id

SiteCompetitorProfile.description:
One tracked competitor for a managed site — SERP/content rival,
not necessarily the same set as the brand's business-level competitors.
SiteCompetitorProfile.title: SiteCompetitorProfile

tools.name: discover_opportunities
tools.description: Turn query signals (fetch these first from the Google Search Console connector's top_queries or striking_distance tools, or from SEO Audit Engine findings) into scored content opportunities for a site, clustered by topic. Creates queue items in 'idea' status for each new opportunity. ASSISTANT POLICY (not enforced by this tool's params): before calling this, ask the user in chat how many articles/opportunities they want surfaced this round — never assume the 'limit' default silently. If the user's answer is ambiguous (e.g. mixed-language phrasing, unclear number, or could mean per-language rather than total — this platform is multilingual), ask a clarifying follow-up instead of guessing.

QuerySignal.description:
One query-level signal, typically fetched from Google Search Console
(top_queries / striking_distance) by the orchestrator and passed in here.
This app does not call other extensions directly — Webbee chains the
GSC connector's output into this tool's input.

source.description: Where this signal came from: gsc|seo_audit|manual
source.title: Source

QuerySignal.title: QuerySignal

site_id.description: Site to discover opportunities for, e.g. 'g4s.md' or 'climtec.md'
site_id.title: Site Id

queries.description: Query signals to turn into opportunities — typically the output of the Google Search Console connector's top_queries or striking_distance tools, fetched first and passed in here. If empty, no opportunities are created (this tool does not fetch GSC data itself).
queries.title: Queries

Opportunity.description: One candidate content opportunity, sourced from GSC / SEO Audit / manual.
Opportunity.title: Opportunity

tools.name: list_opportunities
tools.description: List content opportunities, optionally filtered by site and status.

site_id.description: Optional site filter. Empty = all sites.
site_id.title: Site Id

Opportunity.description: One candidate content opportunity, sourced from GSC / SEO Audit / manual.
Opportunity.title: Opportunity

tools.name: create_brief
tools.description: Generate a structured article brief from an existing opportunity: title direction, search intent, outline skeleton, CTA goal, and image requirement placeholders for the downstream image pipeline. Moves the linked queue item to 'brief_ready'.

opportunity_id.description: UUID of the opportunity to turn into a brief — from list_opportunities, never invented
opportunity_id.title: Opportunity Id

return_schema.description: Structured brief handed downstream to article writing / image planning.
return_schema.title: ArticleBrief

tools.name: build_content_calendar
tools.description: Build a monthly content calendar for a site: assigns scheduled_date slots (on the given weekdays, posts_per_week per week) across the given month to queue items, filling the publication grid. Picks the highest-priority unscheduled brief_ready+ items automatically if queue_item_ids is empty.

site_id.description: Site to build the monthly calendar for, e.g. 'g4s.md'
site_id.title: Site Id

posts_per_week.description: How many publication slots per week to fill
posts_per_week.title: Posts Per Week

weekdays.description: Preferred ISO weekdays for publishing (1=Monday..7=Sunday); cycled to fill posts_per_week
weekdays.title: Weekdays

queue_item_ids.description: Explicit queue items (from list_queue, status brief_ready or later) to place on the grid, in priority order. If empty, the highest-priority unscheduled items for this site are picked automatically.
queue_item_ids.title: Queue Item Ids

ContentCalendarEntry.description: One scheduled slot on the monthly publication grid.
ContentCalendarEntry.title: ContentCalendarEntry

tools.name: get_content_calendar
tools.description: Read the publication grid: queue items that already have a scheduled_date, optionally filtered by site/year/month. Use this to see what is due to publish and when.

site_id.description: Optional site filter. Empty = all sites.
site_id.title: Site Id

ContentCalendarEntry.description: One scheduled slot on the monthly publication grid.
ContentCalendarEntry.title: ContentCalendarEntry

tools.name: link_external_article
tools.description: Record the Article Writer (imperal-article-writer-extension) project_id/article_id once you have created them there for this queue item, so this app's queue keeps a two-way reference between the brief and the actual article being written.

queue_item_id.description: UUID of the queue item to link — from list_queue, never invented
queue_item_id.title: Queue Item Id

external_project_id.description: Article Writer project id (imperal-article-writer-extension), once created
external_project_id.title: External Project Id

external_article_id.description: Article Writer article id, once created via that app's create_article
external_article_id.title: External Article Id

return_schema.description: Editorial workflow state — one row per opportunity/brief in flight.
return_schema.title: QueueItem

tools.name: build_writer_brief
tools.description: Assemble an existing article brief into the exact shape Article Writer (imperal-article-writer-extension) needs for create_project/create_article/generate_article — title, keyword, outline, audience, CTA. Pass the returned fields straight into that app's tools; there is no direct extension-to-extension call, so Webbee relays this data in the same chat turn.

brief_id.description: UUID of an existing article brief — from list_briefs, never invented
brief_id.title: Brief Id

return_schema.description:
Everything Article Writer needs to create_project/create_article/generate_article
for this brief, assembled in the exact shape that app's tools expect. There is no
direct extension-to-extension call here (no cross-extension IPC exists on this
platform) — Webbee reads this entity's fields and passes them into Article Writer's
own tools in the next chat turn. The `body` (from sdl.Bodied) is the full brief as
Markdown, ready to paste as Article Writer's brief/keyword input.
return_schema.title: WriterBrief

tools.name: list_briefs
tools.description: List article briefs, optionally filtered by site.

site_id.description: Optional site filter. Empty = all sites.
site_id.title: Site Id

ArticleBrief.description: Structured brief handed downstream to article writing / image planning.
ArticleBrief.title: ArticleBrief

tools.name: list_queue
tools.description: List the editorial queue — opportunities and briefs tracked through their lifecycle from idea to published. Optionally filter by site and/or lifecycle status.

site_id.description: Optional site filter. Empty = all sites.
site_id.title: Site Id

QueueItem.description: Editorial workflow state — one row per opportunity/brief in flight.
QueueItem.title: QueueItem

tools.name: update_queue_status
tools.description: Move a queue item to a new lifecycle status (idea|brief_ready|draft_requested|draft_ready|approved|published). Set published_url when marking as published.

queue_item_id.description: UUID of the queue item to update — from list_queue, never invented
queue_item_id.title: Queue Item Id

published_url.description: Optional published URL, set when lifecycle_status='published'
published_url.title: Published Url

return_schema.description: Editorial workflow state — one row per opportunity/brief in flight.
return_schema.title: QueueItem

tools.name: list_connected_sites
tools.description: List the sites already connected in other apps (WordPress Hub today, any future site provider) that Quick Add offers as one-click site profile candidates, flagging which ones are already registered here. Also the diagnostic for an empty Quick Add list: it reports whether a provider could not be reached and why.

ConnectedSite.description:
One site read from a site-provider extension (WordPress Hub today,
more providers later) — the raw material behind the Quick Add list.
ConnectedSite.title: ConnectedSite
